en.heroSubtitle: Recognising Trust-Building Tactics Used in Investment Scams
en.intro: Follow a fictional investment journey and learn how scammers build trust through fake identities, official-looking documents, early returns, upselling tactics and withdrawal barriers.

en.shareText: Challenge your friends and see who can spot the scam!

perfect.zh-HK: 非常出色！你能有效識別投資騙局中常見的信任建立技巧、假冒身份及提款陷阱。
perfect.zh-CN: 非常出色！你能有效识别投资骗局中常见的信任建立技巧、假冒身份及提款陷阱。
perfect.en: Excellent! You successfully identified common trust-building tactics, impersonation tricks and withdrawal traps used in investment scams.

pass70.zh-HK: 做得不錯！你已掌握大部分防騙技巧，但仍需留意官方包裝、真實回報及限時優惠帶來的誤導。
pass70.zh-CN: 做得不错！你已掌握大部分防骗技巧，但仍需留意官方包装、真实回报及限时优惠带来的误导。
pass70.en: Well done! You understand most anti-fraud principles, but official-looking materials, real returns and limited-time offers can still be misleading.

below70.zh-HK: 要小心！騙徒往往透過逐步建立信任而非立即行騙。建議仔細閱讀各題詳解。
below70.zh-CN: 要小心！骗徒往往通过逐步建立信任而非立即行骗。建议仔细阅读各题详解。
below70.en: Be careful. Scammers usually build trust gradually rather than revealing the scam immediately. Review the explanations carefully.

title.en: An Unexpected Call from an Investment Adviser

scenario.zh-HK: 你收到一個陌生來電。對方能說出你的姓名，自稱是某大型金融集團的投資顧問，並準確解釋近期市場走勢。你應該如何處理？
scenario.zh-CN: 你收到一个陌生来电。对方能说出你的姓名，自称是某大型金融集团的投资顾问，并准确解释近期市场走势。你应该如何处理？
scenario.en: You receive an unexpected call. The caller knows your name, claims to be an investment adviser from a major financial group, and accurately explains recent market trends. What should you do?

text.zh-HK: 對方知道我的姓名和市場資訊，可以先聽完整個推介
text.zh-CN: 对方知道我的姓名和市场信息，可以先听完整个推介
text.en: The caller knows my name and market information, so I can listen to the full proposal first

text.zh-HK: 要求對方透過公司電郵寄出職員證和產品資料，收到後便可確認身份
text.zh-CN: 要求对方通过公司电邮寄出职员证和产品资料，收到后便可确认身份
text.en: Ask the caller to send an employee card and product information from a company email address, then accept these as proof of identity

text.zh-HK: 結束通話，自行從金融機構官方網站尋找聯絡方法，再直接向機構查證
text.zh-CN: 结束通话，自行从金融机构官方网站寻找联络方法，再直接向机构核实
text.en: End the call, find the institution's contact details independently on its official website, and verify directly with the institution

text.zh-HK: 在網上搜尋對方姓名，找到相同職位的人便繼續聯絡
text.zh-CN: 在网上搜索对方姓名，找到相同职位的人便继续联络
text.en: Search for the caller's name online and continue if someone with the same job title appears

explanation.zh-HK: 姓名、職銜和市場資訊都可能來自公開資料或資料外洩。職員證、顯示名稱和文件亦可以偽造。真正的獨立查證，是不用對方提供的電話、連結或聯絡資料，而是自行經官方渠道聯絡機構。
explanation.zh-CN: 姓名、职衔和市场信息都可能来自公开资料或数据泄露。职员证、显示名称和文件也可以伪造。真正的独立核实，是不使用对方提供的电话、链接或联络资料，而是自行通过官方渠道联络机构。
explanation.en: Names, job titles and market information may come from public sources or leaked data. Employee cards, display names and documents can also be forged. Independent verification means contacting the institution through official channels that you find yourself, rather than using contact details or links supplied by the caller.

reminder.zh-HK: 查證渠道必須獨立於推介者。
reminder.zh-CN: 核实渠道必须独立于推介者。
reminder.en: Verification must be independent of the person making the proposal.

title.zh-HK: 看似官方的電郵是否可信？
title.zh-CN: 看似官方的电邮是否可信？
title.en: Can an Official-Looking Email Be Trusted?

scenario.zh-HK: 對方其後寄來一封設計專業的電郵，附有公司標誌、職員簽署、產品簡介和風險聲明。電郵地址看起來亦很像該金融機構。這代表甚麼？
scenario.zh-CN: 对方其后寄来一封设计专业的电邮，附有公司标志、职员签署、产品简介和风险声明。电邮地址看起来也很像该金融机构。这代表什么？
scenario.en: The caller later sends a professionally designed email containing a company logo, staff signature, product information and a risk statement. The email address also looks similar to that of the financial institution. What does this mean?

text.zh-HK: 大型機構的標誌和風險聲明很難偽造，因此電郵可信
text.zh-CN: 大型机构的标志和风险声明很难伪造，因此电邮可信
text.en: The logos and risk statements of major institutions are difficult to forge, so the email can be trusted

text.zh-HK: 只要電郵地址包含該機構名稱，便可視為官方郵件
text.zh-CN: 只要电邮地址包含该机构名称，便可视为官方邮件
text.en: If the email address contains the institution's name, it can be treated as an official email

text.zh-HK: 如果附件沒有被防毒軟件攔截，便代表寄件者真實
text.zh-CN: 如果附件没有被防毒软件拦截，便代表寄件者真实
text.en: If antivirus software does not block the attachment, the sender must be genuine

text.zh-HK: 這些只屬表面證據，仍須經官方渠道核實寄件者、產品及聯絡資料
text.zh-CN: 这些只属表面证据，仍须通过官方渠道核实寄件者、产品及联络资料
text.en: These are only surface-level signs. The sender, product and contact details must still be verified through official channels

explanation.zh-HK: 騙徒可以複製公司標誌、文件格式和電郵簽署，也可以註冊非常相似的網域。防毒軟件主要檢查惡意程式，不能證明寄件者身份或投資產品真實。
explanation.zh-CN: 骗徒可以复制公司标志、文件格式和电邮签署，也可以注册非常相似的域名。防毒软件主要检查恶意程序，不能证明寄件者身份或投资产品真实。
explanation.en: Scammers can copy company logos, document formats and email signatures, and can register very similar domain names. Antivirus software mainly checks for malicious software. It does not prove that the sender or investment product is genuine.

reminder.zh-HK: 「看起來官方」不等於「已經核實」。
reminder.zh-CN: “看起来官方”不等于“已经核实”。
reminder.en: Looking official is not the same as being verified.

title.en: Can a Genuine Institution Be Impersonated?

scenario.zh-HK: 你查到推介中提及的金融機構確實存在，而且受到監管。是否代表這項投資安全？
scenario.zh-CN: 你查到推介中提及的金融机构确实存在，而且受到监管。是否代表这项投资安全？
scenario.en: You confirm that the financial institution named in the proposal really exists and is regulated. Does this mean the investment is safe?

text.zh-HK: 是，受監管機構不會涉及假投資
text.zh-CN: 是，受监管机构不会涉及假投资
text.en: Yes. A regulated institution would not be connected with a fake investment

text.zh-HK: 未必，還要分別核實聯絡人、投資產品、牌照範圍及收款方
text.zh-CN: 未必，还要分别核实联络人、投资产品、牌照范围及收款方
text.en: Not necessarily. The contact person, investment product, licence scope and payment recipient must each be verified

text.zh-HK: 是，只要公司網站可以正常開啟便足夠
text.zh-CN: 是，只要公司网站可以正常开启便足够
text.en: Yes. It is sufficient if the company's website opens normally

text.zh-HK: 未必，但只要要求對方再次提供職員證便可以
text.zh-CN: 未必，但只要要求对方再次提供职员证便可以
text.en: Not necessarily, but asking the caller to provide an employee card again would be sufficient

explanation.zh-HK: 騙徒可以冒用真實機構的名稱。即使機構本身存在，也不代表聯絡你的人屬於該機構，更不代表有關產品由該機構提供。公司、聯絡人、產品、牌照和收款帳戶應分開核實。
explanation.zh-CN: 骗徒可以冒用真实机构的名称。即使机构本身存在，也不代表联络你的人属于该机构，更不代表有关产品由该机构提供。公司、联络人、产品、牌照和收款账户应分别核实。
explanation.en: Scammers may misuse the name of a genuine institution. The existence of the institution does not prove that the person contacting you works there or that the institution offers the product. The company, contact person, product, licence and receiving account should be verified separately.

reminder.zh-CN: 真实公司也可能被冒认。
reminder.en: A genuine company can still be impersonated.

title.zh-HK: 專業包裝是否代表產品可靠？
title.zh-CN: 专业包装是否代表产品可靠？
title.en: Does Professional Presentation Make a Product Reliable?

scenario.zh-HK: 對方推介一項結合債券、股票和環保項目的新投資產品，並表示產品只開放給指定客戶。你未能完全理解產品結構，但對方提供了詳細圖表。你應該怎樣做？
scenario.zh-CN: 对方推介一项结合债券、股票和环保项目的新投资产品，并表示产品只开放给指定客户。你未能完全理解产品结构，但对方提供了详细图表。你应该怎样做？
scenario.en: The adviser promotes a new investment product combining bonds, shares and environmental projects, and says it is available only to selected clients. You do not fully understand its structure, but the adviser provides detailed charts. What should you do?

text.zh-HK: 圖表十分詳細，代表產品經過專業設計，可以先小額參與
text.zh-CN: 图表十分详细，代表产品经过专业设计，可以先小额参与
text.en: The detailed charts show that the product was professionally designed, so I can start with a small investment

text.zh-HK: 請對方以更簡單的方式再解釋一次，聽明白後便可立即投資
text.zh-CN: 请对方以更简单的方式再解释一次，听明白后便可立即投资
text.en: Ask the adviser to explain it more simply, then invest immediately once the explanation is understandable

text.zh-HK: 暫停交易，透過持牌機構或獨立專業人士核實產品是否存在及了解風險
text.zh-CN: 暂停交易，通过持牌机构或独立专业人士核实产品是否存在及了解风险
text.en: Pause the transaction and use a licensed institution or independent professional to verify that the product exists and understand its risks

text.zh-HK: 詢問其他參加者是否曾經獲利，有人獲利便可以參與
text.zh-CN: 询问其他参加者是否曾经获利，有人获利便可以参与
text.en: Ask whether other participants have made a profit and invest if someone says they have

explanation.zh-HK: 複雜名稱和圖表可能營造專業形象，但不能證明產品存在。如果投資者未能清楚理解產品如何運作、可能損失多少及由誰監管，便不應付款。
explanation.zh-CN: 复杂名称和图表可能营造专业形象，但不能证明产品存在。如果投资者未能清楚理解产品如何运作、可能损失多少及由谁监管，便不应付款。
explanation.en: Complex names and charts may create a professional image, but they do not prove that a product exists. You should not pay if you cannot clearly understand how the product works, how much you could lose and who regulates it.

reminder.zh-HK: 不理解的產品，不應只因包裝專業而投資。
reminder.zh-CN: 不理解的产品，不应只因包装专业而投资。
reminder.en: Do not invest in a product you do not understand merely because it looks professional.

title.en: Is a Small Trial Investment Safe?

scenario.zh-HK: 對方提議你先投入一筆可以承受損失的小額資金，強調這只是「試用」，稍後可以隨時退出。以下哪些說法正確？（多選）
scenario.zh-CN: 对方提议你先投入一笔可以承受损失的小额资金，强调这只是“试用”，稍后可以随时退出。以下哪些说法正确？（多选）
scenario.en: The adviser suggests starting with a small amount that you can afford to lose, describing it as a trial that you can leave at any time. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

text.zh-HK: 即使金額很小，仍應先核實機構及產品
text.zh-CN: 即使金额很小，仍应先核实机构及产品
text.en: Even for a small amount, the institution and product should still be verified first

text.zh-HK: 小額付款可能是對方建立信任和付款習慣的第一步
text.zh-CN: 小额付款可能是对方建立信任和付款习惯的第一步
text.en: A small payment may be the first step in building trust and a habit of making payments

text.zh-HK: 只要金額不大，投資是否真實並不重要
text.zh-CN: 只要金额不大，投资是否真实并不重要
text.en: If the amount is small, whether the investment is genuine is not important

text.zh-HK: 收到小額回報後，便可放心增加投資
text.zh-CN: 收到小额回报后，便可放心增加投资
text.en: After receiving a small return, it is safe to increase the investment

explanation.zh-HK: 小額投資不能取代查證。第一次投資金額較小，可能使人放低戒心。一旦完成首次付款並投入時間，日後便可能更容易接受追加投資。能否承受損失與投資是否真實，是兩個不同問題。
explanation.zh-CN: 小额投资不能取代核实。第一次投资金额较小，可能使人放低戒心。一旦完成首次付款并投入时间，日后便可能更容易接受追加投资。能否承受损失与投资是否真实，是两个不同问题。
explanation.en: A small investment is not a substitute for verification. A small first payment may lower your caution. After making the first payment and committing time, you may become more willing to invest again. Being able to afford a loss and determining whether an investment is genuine are two different matters.

reminder.zh-HK: 「小額試試」可能是信任陷阱的起點。
reminder.zh-CN: “小额试试”可能是信任陷阱的起点。
reminder.en: A small trial may be the beginning of a trust trap.

title.zh-HK: 收到真實回報代表甚麼？
title.zh-CN: 收到真实回报代表什么？
title.en: What Does a Real Return Prove?

scenario.zh-HK: 數星期後，你真的收到一筆回報，而且款項已進入你的銀行帳戶。你應如何理解這件事？
scenario.zh-CN: 数星期后，你真的收到一笔回报，而且款项已进入你的银行账户。你应如何理解这件事？
scenario.en: Several weeks later, you receive a return and the money reaches your bank account. How should you interpret this?

text.zh-HK: 銀行已收到款項，因此足以證明投資真實
text.zh-CN: 银行已收到款项，因此足以证明投资真实
text.en: The payment reached my bank account, so the investment must be genuine

text.zh-HK: 收到回報代表對方一定持有適當的金融牌照
text.zh-CN: 收到回报代表对方一定持有适当的金融牌照
text.en: Receiving a return proves that the adviser holds the proper financial licence

text.zh-HK: 成功收到一次款項，代表將來一定可以提取全部本金
text.zh-CN: 成功收到一次款项，代表将来一定可以提取全部本金
text.en: Receiving one payment means that the full principal can definitely be withdrawn later

text.zh-HK: 真實回報可能只是建立信任的手段，不能單獨證明投資真實
text.zh-CN: 真实回报可能只是建立信任的手段，不能单独证明投资真实
text.en: A real return may be used to build trust and cannot by itself prove that the investment is genuine

explanation.zh-HK: 騙徒可能願意先支付小額回報，以換取更大的信任和後續投資。這筆錢可能來自你的本金、其他人的付款，或騙徒預留的誘餌成本。收到真錢，不等於背後存在真實的投資活動。
explanation.zh-CN: 骗徒可能愿意先支付小额回报，以换取更大的信任和后续投资。这笔钱可能来自你的本金、其他人的付款，或骗徒预留的诱饵成本。收到真金钱，不等于背后存在真实的投资活动。
explanation.en: Scammers may pay a small early return to gain greater trust and encourage further investment. The payment may come from your original funds, payments made by other people, or money set aside as bait. Receiving real money does not prove that genuine investment activity exists behind it.

reminder.zh-HK: 真回報也可以是騙局的一部分。
reminder.zh-CN: 真实回报也可以是骗局的一部分。
reminder.en: A real payment can still be part of a scam.

title.en: What Can One Successful Return Prove?

scenario.zh-HK: 對方指出：「你已經親自收到回報，這比任何網上警告都更可靠。」根據你收到一次回報的事實，以下哪些說法正確？（多選）
scenario.zh-CN: 对方指出：“你已经亲自收到回报，这比任何网上警告都更可靠。”根据你收到一次回报的事实，以下哪些说法正确？（多选）
scenario.en: The adviser says: "You have already received a return yourself. That is more reliable than any online warning." Based on the fact that you received one return, which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

text.zh-HK: 這只能證明有人曾經向你付款
text.zh-CN: 这只能证明有人曾经向你付款
text.en: It only proves that someone made a payment to you

text.zh-HK: 這不能證明整項投資真實存在或受到適當監管
text.zh-CN: 这不能证明整项投资真实存在或受到适当监管
text.en: It does not prove that the investment is genuine or properly regulated

text.zh-HK: 這代表投資風險已經消失
text.zh-CN: 这代表投资风险已经消失
text.en: It means that the investment risk has disappeared

text.zh-HK: 這代表未來一定能成功提取本金和所有回報
text.zh-CN: 这代表未来一定能成功提取本金和所有回报
text.en: It means that the principal and all future returns can definitely be withdrawn

explanation.zh-HK: 一次或數次成功收款，只能證明有人向你付款。這不能證明款項來自真正的投資收益，也不能證明產品、機構、聯絡人或收款安排受到適當監管。個別經驗不能取代完整查證。
explanation.zh-CN: 一次或数次成功收款，只能证明有人向你付款。这不能证明款项来自真正的投资收益，也不能证明产品、机构、联络人或收款安排受到适当监管。个别经验不能取代完整核实。
explanation.en: One or several successful payments only prove that someone paid you. They do not prove that the money came from genuine investment returns or that the product, institution, adviser or payment arrangement is properly regulated. A personal experience does not replace full verification.

reminder.zh-HK: 個別結果不能取代完整查證。
reminder.zh-CN: 个别结果不能取代完整核实。
reminder.en: A single result cannot replace full verification.

title.zh-HK: 曾經獲利，是否應該加碼？
title.zh-CN: 曾经获利，是否应该加码？
title.en: Should Past Success Lead to a Larger Investment?

scenario.zh-HK: 在你收到回報後，對方表示只有現有客戶才可參加一個限時升級計劃，投入金額愈大，回報率愈高。你應該如何處理？
scenario.zh-CN: 在你收到回报后，对方表示只有现有客户才可参加一个限时升级计划，投入金额越大，回报率越高。你应该如何处理？
scenario.en: After receiving a return, you are invited to a limited-time upgrade plan available only to existing clients. The adviser promises higher return rates for larger investments. What should you do?

text.zh-HK: 過往有成功經驗，可以合理地增加投入
text.zh-CN: 过往有成功经验，可以合理地增加投入
text.en: Past success provides a good reason to invest more

text.zh-HK: 只把收到的回報再投入，便不算承受新的風險
text.zh-CN: 只把收到的回报再投入，便不算承担新的风险
text.en: Reinvesting only the returns does not create any new risk

text.zh-HK: 每次新增投資都要重新評估，並警惕限時優惠及階梯式回報帶來的壓力
text.zh-CN: 每次新增投资都要重新评估，并警惕限时优惠及阶梯式回报带来的压力
text.en: Treat every new investment as a fresh decision and be cautious of time pressure and escalating return promises

text.zh-HK: 先增加投資，再在下一次獲利後取回本金
text.zh-CN: 先增加投资，再在下一次获利后取回本金
text.en: Invest more now and withdraw the principal after the next return

explanation.zh-HK: 過往曾經獲得回報，可能令人低估風險。限時、專屬資格和更高級別待遇，經常被用來製造錯失機會的壓力。每次增加投資都應視為新的財務決定，並重新核實相關資料。
explanation.zh-CN: 过往曾经获得回报，可能令人低估风险。限时、专属资格和更高级别待遇，经常被用来制造错失机会的压力。每次增加投资都应视为新的财务决定，并重新核实相关资料。
explanation.en: Past returns may cause people to underestimate risk. Limited-time offers, exclusive access and higher reward levels are often used to create fear of missing out. Every additional investment should be treated as a new financial decision and verified again.

reminder.zh-HK: 過往成功不保證下一次交易安全。
reminder.zh-CN: 过往成功不保证下一次交易安全。
reminder.en: Past success does not guarantee that the next transaction is safe.

scenario.zh-HK: 對方要求你把款項轉到一家海外公司的銀行帳戶，而不是推介產品的金融機構，並解釋這是「國際結算及託管安排」。以下哪些做法較適當？（多選）
scenario.zh-CN: 对方要求你把款项转到一家海外公司的银行账户，而不是推介产品的金融机构，并解释这是“国际结算及托管安排”。以下哪些做法较适当？（多选）
scenario.en: You are asked to transfer funds to the bank account of an overseas company instead of the financial institution promoting the product. The adviser describes this as an international settlement and custody arrangement. Which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.

text.zh-HK: 暫停付款，未完成查證前不要轉帳
text.zh-CN: 暂停付款，未完成核实前不要转账
text.en: Pause the payment and do not transfer any money until verification is complete

text.zh-HK: 獨立核實收款公司與投資產品及金融機構的關係
text.zh-CN: 独立核实收款公司与投资产品及金融机构的关系
text.en: Independently verify the relationship between the receiving company, investment product and financial institution

text.zh-HK: 核實合約主體、收款人、託管安排及監管資料是否一致
text.zh-CN: 核实合约主体、收款人、托管安排及监管资料是否一致
text.en: Check whether the contracting party, payment recipient, custody arrangement and regulatory information are consistent

text.zh-HK: 只要對方能以專業方式解釋第三方收款安排，便可付款
text.zh-CN: 只要对方能以专业方式解释第三方收款安排，便可付款
text.en: Proceed with payment if the adviser gives a professional explanation for the third-party account

explanation.zh-HK: 推介者、產品提供者、合約主體及收款人名稱不一致，是重大警號。複雜或專業的解釋不能取代正式文件和獨立核實。款項一旦轉到海外或第三方帳戶，追討難度可能大幅增加。
explanation.zh-CN: 推介者、产品提供者、合约主体及收款人名称不一致，是重大警号。复杂或专业的解释不能取代正式文件和独立核实。款项一旦转到海外或第三方账户，追讨难度可能大幅增加。
explanation.en: Differences between the promoter, product provider, contracting party and payment recipient are major warning signs. A complex or professional explanation cannot replace formal documents and independent verification. Recovering money may become much more difficult after it is transferred to an overseas or third-party account.

reminder.zh-HK: 收款人不一致時，應先停、再查，不應先付款。
reminder.zh-CN: 收款人不一致时，应先停、再查，不应先付款。
reminder.en: When payment details do not match, stop and verify before paying.

scenario.zh-HK: 你要求提取本金，對方表示帳戶正接受合規審查，需要先支付一筆保證金。完成後，保證金和本金會一併退還。你應該怎樣做？
scenario.zh-CN: 你要求提取本金，对方表示账户正在接受合规审查，需要先支付一笔保证金。完成后，保证金和本金会一并退还。你应该怎样做？
scenario.en: You request to withdraw your principal, but the adviser says that your account is under a compliance review and that a security deposit must be paid first. The deposit and principal will supposedly be returned together. What should you do?

text.zh-HK: 停止付款，立即聯絡銀行並保存所有證據
text.zh-CN: 停止付款，立即联络银行并保存所有证据
text.en: Stop making payments, contact your bank immediately and preserve all evidence

text.zh-HK: 要求對方降低保證金金額後再付款
text.zh-CN: 要求对方降低保证金金额后再付款
text.en: Ask the adviser to reduce the deposit before paying it

text.zh-HK: 改用另一個銀行帳戶支付保證金
text.zh-CN: 改用另一个银行账户支付保证金
text.en: Use a different bank account to pay the deposit

text.zh-HK: 分期支付保證金，以降低單次付款風險
text.zh-CN: 分期支付保证金，以降低单次付款风险
text.en: Pay the deposit in instalments to reduce the risk of each payment

explanation.zh-HK: 要求受害人再付款才能取回資金，是常見的二次詐騙手法。費用可能被稱為稅款、保證金、解凍費、手續費或合規費，但基本結構相同。切勿為追回舊款而投入新款。
explanation.zh-CN: 要求受害人再付款才能取回资金，是常见的二次诈骗手法。费用可能被称为税款、保证金、解冻费、手续费或合规费，但基本结构相同。切勿为追回旧款而投入新款。
explanation.en: Requiring a victim to make another payment before funds can be released is a common secondary scam tactic. The payment may be described as tax, a security deposit, an account release fee, an administration charge or a compliance fee, but the basic pattern is the same. Never send new money in an attempt to recover money already paid.

reminder.zh-HK: 提款前再付款，是立即停止交易的重大警號。
reminder.zh-CN: 提款前再付款，是立即停止交易的重大警号。
reminder.en: Being asked to pay before withdrawing funds is a major warning sign to stop immediately.

dialogues.speaker: 投資顧問
dialogues.text: 只差最後一筆保證金。付款後，你之前投入的資金和所有回報都可以取回。

dialogues.speaker: 投資者
dialogues.text: 我已經投入了很多錢。如果現在停止，之前的錢就可能全部失去。

dialogues.speaker: 投资顾问
dialogues.text: 只差最后一笔保证金。付款后，你之前投入的资金和所有回报都可以取回。

dialogues.speaker: 投资者
dialogues.text: 我已经投入了很多钱。如果现在停止，之前的钱就可能全部失去。

dialogues.speaker: Investment Adviser
dialogues.text: Only one final security deposit is required. After you pay it, you can withdraw all the money you invested and all the returns.

dialogues.speaker: Investor
dialogues.text: I have already invested a lot of money. If I stop now, I may lose everything I have already paid.

question.zh-HK: 投資者的想法最能反映以下哪一種心理陷阱？
question.zh-CN: 投资者的想法最能反映以下哪一种心理陷阱？
question.en: Which psychological trap is best reflected in the investor's thinking?

text.zh-HK: 從眾效應
text.zh-CN: 从众效应
text.en: Bandwagon effect

text.zh-HK: 沉沒成本效應
text.zh-CN: 沉没成本效应
text.en: Sunk cost effect

text.zh-HK: 權威效應
text.zh-CN: 权威效应
text.en: Authority bias

text.zh-HK: 確認偏誤
text.zh-CN: 确认偏误
text.en: Confirmation bias

explanation.zh-HK: 沉沒成本效應是指人們因為已投入金錢、時間或心力，而繼續作出本來不合理的決定。過去的損失無法透過增加新風險自動挽回。此時應根據目前掌握的事實重新判斷，而不是被過去的投入綁架。
explanation.zh-CN: 沉没成本效应是指人们因为已投入金钱、时间或心力，而继续作出本来不合理的决定。过去的损失无法通过增加新风险自动挽回。此时应根据目前掌握的事实重新判断，而不是被过去的投入绑架。
explanation.en: The sunk cost effect occurs when people continue making an unreasonable decision because they have already invested money, time or effort. Past losses cannot automatically be recovered by taking further risks. The decision should be reconsidered using the facts currently available, rather than being controlled by what has already been spent.

reminder.zh-HK: 已經付出的金錢，不應成為繼續付款的理由。
reminder.zh-CN: 已经付出的金钱，不应成为继续付款的理由。
reminder.en: Money already spent should not become a reason to keep paying.

title.en: What Should You Do If You Suspect a Scam?

scenario.zh-HK: 你開始懷疑自己遇上投資騙局。以下哪些行動是適當的？（多選）
scenario.zh-CN: 你开始怀疑自己遇上投资骗局。以下哪些行动是适当的？（多选）
scenario.en: You begin to suspect that you may be involved in an investment scam. Which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.

text.zh-HK: 立即停止付款，不再按對方要求轉帳
text.zh-CN: 立即停止付款，不再按对方要求转账
text.en: Stop making payments immediately and do not follow further transfer instructions

text.zh-HK: 保存電話、電郵、網址、對話及交易紀錄
text.zh-CN: 保存电话、电邮、网址、对话及交易纪录
text.en: Preserve phone details, emails, website addresses, conversations and transaction records

text.zh-HK: 盡快聯絡銀行，說明懷疑受騙及查詢可採取的措施
text.zh-CN: 尽快联络银行，说明怀疑受骗及查询可采取的措施
text.en: Contact your bank promptly, explain that you suspect fraud and ask what action can be taken

text.zh-HK: 透過官方渠道尋求協助；如曾提供密碼或敏感資料，亦應檢查帳戶安全
text.zh-CN: 通过官方渠道寻求协助；如曾提供密码或敏感资料，也应检查账户安全
text.en: Seek help through official channels and check account security if passwords or sensitive information were provided

text.zh-HK: 刪除所有對話和交易紀錄，以免再看到相關內容
text.zh-CN: 删除所有对话和交易纪录，以免再看到相关内容
text.en: Delete all conversations and transaction records so that you no longer have to see them

text.zh-HK: 再支付一筆較小款項，測試對方是否真的容許提款
text.zh-CN: 再支付一笔较小款项，测试对方是否真的允许提款
text.en: Make one more small payment to test whether the adviser will really allow a withdrawal

explanation.zh-HK: 懷疑受騙時，時間十分重要。應立即停止付款及聯絡銀行，並保存電話、電郵、網址、收款資料、對話和交易紀錄。如曾提供密碼或敏感資料，應更改密碼並檢查帳戶安全。不要因尷尬、職位或損失金額而延遲求助。
explanation.zh-CN: 怀疑受骗时，时间十分重要。应立即停止付款及联络银行，并保存电话、电邮、网址、收款资料、对话和交易纪录。如曾提供密码或敏感资料，应更改密码并检查账户安全。不要因尴尬、职位或损失金额而延迟求助。
explanation.en: Time is important when fraud is suspected. Stop making payments, contact your bank and preserve phone details, emails, website addresses, payment information, conversations and transaction records. If passwords or sensitive information were provided, change the passwords and check the security of the affected accounts. Do not delay seeking help because of embarrassment, position or the amount lost.

reminder.zh-HK: 立即停、保存證據、聯絡銀行及透過官方渠道求助。
reminder.zh-CN: 立即停、保存证据、联络银行及通过官方渠道求助。
reminder.en: Stop immediately, preserve evidence, contact your bank and seek help through official channels.
